actions.text:
plt.title("Sine wave: A=1, f=2 Hz, phase=0")  # state what the figure shows
plt.xlabel("Time (s)")  # label the horizontal axis and its unit
plt.ylabel("Amplitude")  # label the vertical axis and its unit
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)  # add a grid so values are easy to read
plt.tight_layout()  # keep labels from being clipped
plt.show()  # render and show the figure

clips.caption: Then add a title and axis labels, so a reader knows what each axis means.
Now plot the x just generated, and <c.aqua>predict</c.aqua> first how many full cycles fit in one second.
Draw the waveform. One second should hold two full cycles. The horizontal axis is time, the vertical axis is <c.aqua>amplitude</c.aqua>; look for peaks, troughs and zero crossings.
